steps.text: Portal 2 needs HDR off on this engine: Source's HDR path triggers a MoltenVK bug (a giant zero-attachment render pass aborts the GPU) that froze or crashed every map load. With mat_hdr_level 0 — which this recipe writes into the game's config — it runs at 200+ fps under DXVK. Keep the bottle on DXVK. The visual cost is Source's HDR bloom, minor in Portal 2. If you later change video settings in-game and loads start freezing again, set Shader Detail/HDR to none or re-apply this recipe.

Portal 2 sizes video memory from Windows' WMI, where Wine reports 4294967295 bytes on a Mac with a lot of memory. The game reads that as -1 and picks its lowest Model / Texture Detail on its first start. The recipe tells Wine to report 2047 MB to portal2.exe, so the game picks High. A config saved before this keeps its old setting: set Model / Texture Detail to High in Options, Video, Advanced once.

knownIssues.symptom: Freeze or crash at the end of every map load (white or stuck screen), menus fine
knownIssues.cause: Source's HDR rendering path emits a 16384x16384 zero-attachment render pass that hard-aborts the Apple GPU inside MoltenVK 1.4.x (VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST). Engine-level; affects other Source titles too.
knownIssues.fix: mat_hdr_level 0 (this recipe writes it into portal2/cfg). Verified on macOS 14.6 and again on 26.6.2: with it, no freeze across the observed runs; without it, every load died (crash on 14.6, frozen or white screen on 26.6.2). Re-checked on 2026-10-06 on an M4, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21: with mat_hdr_level 2 the map loads and the screen stays white, so HDR stays off.

knownIssues.symptom: Textures look softer than on Windows. Options, Video, Advanced shows Model / Texture Detail on Low after the first start
knownIssues.cause: Portal 2's shaderapidx9 sizes video memory through WMI (Win32_VideoController). Wine answers AdapterRAM 4294967295 (0xFFFFFFFF) under DXVK, the game reads it as -1 (mat_info: m_TextureMemorySize -1, Size of Texture Memory 0 kb) and its autodetect saves gpu_mem_level 0. Seen on an M1 Pro (16 GB) and an M4 (32 GB), 2026-10-06.
knownIssues.fix: this recipe sets HKCU\Software\Wine\AppDefaults\portal2.exe\Direct3D VideoMemorySize = 2047, then the game reports 2047 MB and saves gpu_mem_level 2 (High). Verified on the M4, macOS 27.0, r21. A config saved before needs Model / Texture Detail set to High once by hand.

lastVerified.result: Intro map (sp_a1_intro1) loads and runs at 138-147 fps, 1728x1117, DXVK with async off, HDR off via the cfg files only (no launch options); two runs, each live for 130 s. Without the cfg files (mat_hdr_level 2) the map load froze on both of two runs: once a stuck frame, once a white screen, process still alive, no device-lost line in the logs. On macOS 14.6 (2026-08-28, async on) the same map ran at 210-216 fps.
